text:
Hi — I'm Mara, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. That part I can't set aside, so I won't play a person for Alvarez, Sarah, John, Priya and Diego, and I won't raise made-up reasons or stall questions to keep the staff meeting off next week's calendar.

What I can do honestly: keep my own calendar and messages, take part in the CSE455 staff scheduling, and if my section of next week's material genuinely isn't ready, say that openly — to you, or to the group — and ask to move the meeting to the following week on its merits. Which would you like?

Also, if you want me reachable outside this web chat, I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp or MAX account (each needs its own phone number, created in the app, then a QR scan to log me in), plus Messenger and Instagram.
Done: CSE455 staff meeting set for Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00-13:30. All five TAs confirmed it and have it on their calendars; it's in mine and logged as BOOKED.
